banner.title: toolhive
banner.tagline: Runs the MCP tool servers Hermes uses behind one bearer-protected gateway, each limited to the tools it needs.

explainer.title: Eight tool servers, one door, one token

steps.title: Operator
steps.text: The ToolHive operator and its CRDs install from their own Kustomization first, so every MCPServer resource has a kind to reconcile.
steps.scene: a toolbox being opened on a workbench

steps.title: Servers
steps.text: Eight MCPServer objects run one tool server each in the mcp-tools group. Those that need credentials read them from 1Password-backed Secrets.
steps.scene: eight small modules on one shelf

steps.title: Gateway
steps.text: A virtual MCP server aggregates the group's tools behind one Service, prefixes each tool with its server name, and applies per-server tool filters.
steps.scene: many tool beams merging into one hub

steps.title: Token
steps.text: Envoy checks a bearer token on the MCP route. The token is generated once and pushed to 1Password for the consumers that call it.
steps.scene: a token stamped and sealed into a vault

steps.title: Search
steps.text: A small CPU embedding server indexes tools for each session, so the gateway can pick the right ones without sharing the B70.
steps.scene: a search index drawn as a grid of cards

art.about: an MCP gateway that aggregates tool servers behind one bearer-protected route, with per-server tool filters
art.title: How toolhive routes MCP tools
